design: Compact daruma silhouette: broad domed crown, slightly narrower upper body, fuller middle/lower sides, rounded lower corners and shallow curved base. One continuous body, no neck, collar, legs or feet. Not a perfect circle or tall capsule.
titleIntegration: Preserve the existing live A glyph and all per-letter hover. Do not use a raster title replacement.

targetSizing.source: Measure the live A slot after fonts load and remeasure on resize/layout changes.
targetSizing.frame: Scale the complete frame uniformly, account for its 16px margins and align the visible base to the glyph baseline/bottom.

expressionInvariant: All pixels outside mouthPatch are identical across the three supplied full-body poses.
